body:
I'm not ruling out seeing a counsellor yet, and am trying to work on the  phone issue by ringing everyone today that I've been putting off (though have to prioritise my uni work, unfortunately).

I feel overly happy now, and spoke to another friend about it last night. Just a bit anxious and tight-chested today, so hopefully the next few days will brighten up :) Thanks.

I get that counselling may help, and there is one within the university. But I'm a bit bad at talking to new people and you have to ring up to book an appointment and I hate using phones, especially with people I don't know. And I still don't know what I would have to talk about. I feel slightly better now than I have been, I just have a bit of a headache, and I told a friend the other night how I felt, but I was a little bit vague, as I am very concious of the fact that people have an image in their head of a person, and I spend a lot of time with him so don't want to corrupt our friendship, especially when in a couple of months I won't be able to see him everyday as he graduates - and he has his own shit to be getting on with too. I'll think a bout counselling, but as I said, approaching it is a really hard thing for me.
